purpose: Stop automatic semantic learning from spending a model call on pure social room exchanges while keeping extraction for real topics.
constraints: identity, authority, persona and common instructions were not summarized, truncated or removed
no extra model call is used to decide whether to learn; the gate is deterministic Rust
model selection, routing and the nine participants were unchanged
manual /api/rooms/:id/learn still enqueues an explicit semantic job
the live engine on port 4317 was not touched

method.engine: isolated copy on 127.0.0.1:4318 with a copied runtime database
method.gate: skip only when the current owner turn is social-only and the exchange has no successful tool evidence and no explicit correction wording
method.watermark: the social exchange is marked processed only when no earlier unprocessed work sits before it
method.counting: jobs where input.roomLearning=true and input.roomId=nazarick-circle; audit event room.knowledge_skipped; audit model.usage purpose helper

not_claimed: the 27 normal participant chat calls still consume tokens; this change removes only the extra semantic learning call for greetings
a live topic turn was not re-measured in this run; the scripted E2E proves the gate still enqueues and completes extraction for a topic exchange
two startup resume jobs failed on stale recovery state before the first greeting and made no model calls; they are unrelated to the learning gate
